spec: Admit [start, end, seats] leases against limit >= 0 (end > start, seats >= 0 else ValueError): drop active leases with prev_end <= start before checking sum + seats <= limit.
For band [low, high) (high > low, else ValueError) and [left, right, weight] spans, clip spans with right > left to [low, high) and return [sum(overlap * weight), positive_overlap_count].

Over [kind, ch, seq] events: 'msg' (seq >= 1, else ValueError) emits seq - mark and sets mark = seq if seq > mark (initial 0) else emits 0; 'reset' clears only ch mark to 0 (other kinds raise ValueError).
Over [op, val] ops: 'add' adds val to cur and updates peak; 'soft' resets cur=0 keeping peak; 'hard' appends peak (None if no 'add' in batch) and resets cur=0, peak=None (else ValueError).
With inventory {part: count} (counts >= 0, else ValueError) and sequential part-list kits, atomically deduct a kit iff all repeated part counts fit; return booleans.
Count distinct panels containing each non-empty tag (threshold >= 1 else ValueError) and return sorted tags with count >= threshold.

Cache (capacity >= 1 else ValueError) over [op, key]: 'put' moves resident key to newest (keeping pin) or evicts oldest unpinned if full (ValueError if all pinned); 'pin'/'unpin' set resident pin. Return [evictions, order].

Select [name, grp, score] candidates by descending score (tie: earlier index) while group_caps[grp] > 0 (caps >= 0 else ValueError; missing grp has cap 0), returning selected names in input index order.
